[P2] Preserve context observations when partial collection omits them

If an earlier phase retained a task or resource in `context.evidence`, a partial collection response that omits it replaces the only retained inventory here. Retirement is then audited against the reduced snapshot, permitting target reuse without settling the previously observed work and removing that observation from the result. Freeze context-held evidence before calling `collect_partial` and retain all known work for retirement auditing; reject omissions instead of replacing the baseline. Cover a partial response that drops a context-held task.
